title: Hadithi (Theme 14: Kuweka akiba)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the hadithi in its kind and occasion, explains its lugha with an example, and presents it with the audience taking part.

floor.prerequisite: Tells a riddle or a story with the formula.
floor.question: Kitendawili! - ?

representations: a recording or a performance of "Chungu na Panzi: Chungu aliweka akiba, Panzi aliimba tu"
steps: Listen to or read the text.
Explain its lugha with an example.
contexts: an evening of stories at home

board.do: Chungu na Panzi: Chungu aliweka akiba, Panzi aliimba tu

board.say: Hii ni hadithi ya aina gani, na inatumika lini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child presents a short piece with the class responding.

misconceptions.repair: Ni tanakali za sauti: huleta uhai na burudani
Lugha ya picha ina maana iliyofichika.
Eleza kazi ya kipengele: kinasisitiza, kinajenga picha, kinaburudisha.

checks.question: "Panzi aliimba "tia tia tia"" ni kipengele gani cha lugha?
Kipengele cha tanakali za sauti kina umuhimu gani?
